description.value: Wenjie Chinese Restaurant is a sit-down Chinese restaurant in Comox on Vancouver Island, serving a broad menu of Cantonese and Szechuan classics made fresh in-house from quality ingredients. The kitchen covers chow mein, fried rice, egg foo young, seafood, and hot-and-spicy Szechuan dishes alongside combination dinner platters. Touring cyclists riding the Comox Valley will find it a convenient option for a full hot meal after a day on the road.
